question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**interminable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**interminable**" means endless or seemingly endless, often used to describe something that feels like it has no end. (अंतहीन)

 
 
• **Example:** The interminable journey through the dense forest left us all exhausted.
 
 
 
• The passage describes the journey as seeming endless due to the complete darkness and rolling clouds, making "**interminable**" the most fitting option.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bordered** (सीमाबद्ध): "Bordered" refers to being enclosed or surrounded by a boundary, which does not fit the context of the journey feeling endless.

 
 
• **Example:** The garden was bordered by a beautiful white fence.
 
 
 
• **Confined** (सीमित): "Confined" means restricted or limited, which does not align with the context of the journey feeling endless.
 
 
• **Example:** The confined space of the room made it difficult to breathe.
 
 
 
• **Limited** (सीमित): "Limited" refers to being restricted in amount or scope, which does not convey the sense of endlessness implied in the passage.
 
 
• **Example:** The offer was available for a limited time only.
